'Local 222 Drive Chapter' (p4 row 12) is transcribed verbatim as printed. Two apparent filer typos are kept verbatim per the contract: 'John Willliams' (three l's, p4 row 35) and Utah County Association of Realtors' ZIP-shaped '8407-5205' (discarded as ZIP anyway). Expenditure purposes 'Refund for conribution in excess of cap' (row 3) and '2015 golf tournamnet photos' are the filer's own spellings, verbatim.

expenditures.detail: 109 rows sum to 76,029.84 = the attachment's printed TOTAL (foot of p8) = Summary Page line 2 Column A AND Column B.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p6) stubs print SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL and BOTH are left BLANK (the filer wrote 'See attached schedule' on line 1 of each) - no county-form subtotal gate exists on this filing. Both close to the cent.
